share_rules.note: D20: shares must sum to 100%; main >=50%; main failure halves SIDE score before rate computation (not payout); no separate grade cap — D12 chain degrades naturally.

achievement_rate.note: D20/T11/T12: 体量 = 理论最高分 = 分母; shares sum to 100% so full completion = rate 1.0.

failure_grade_note: F is an independent failure state handled by D14 simplified penalty (credits only); it has no coefficient in this table.

payout.note: D20: base output = volume, rate 1:1. tier_coefficient remains from the 09 table (this decision only defines the multiplication relationship).

ratified.T4: volume declared by instance, bounded by share rules; no通关 record requirement
ratified.E_F: E=0.1; F handled as failure state, no coefficient
